method: Final paired production client benchmark: 5 trials, alternating baseline/after and reversing order each trial; medians. Immutable START_HEAD versus candidate, identical local HTTP server and deterministic API. Chromium 4x CPU, 10 sellers, showcase full effects. Navigation-to-visible-goal, then fonts/visible-product decode readiness. Real Playwright pointer clicks to visible state, including actionability waits; next sale during celebration. No physical touch/cashier or remote network claim. Earlier development and initial production samples retained separately; final paired data is authoritative. Asset transfer collected separately without clock emulation.

earlyDevelopmentMeasurement.method: START_HEAD 54f6b95 baseline versus working tree, identical Vite React servers 5212/5213, 4x Chromium CPU, 3 trials median, identical 10-seller mocked API, real click to visible state. Initial readiness includes navigation/lazy modules. Not physical hardware or production network.

polling.notes: Steady state estimates excluding initial load, sales, retries, filters and clock boundary refreshes. Cadence/pause/resume are verified with virtual-clock browser and unit tests.

fightCenter.method: Actual React UI at 4x CDP CPU throttle, deterministic test payloads, median of 3 trials. Initial opens include navigation and lazy JS; tab switches include the actual Playwright click and visible DOM wait. Local production client build, not physical cash-register hardware and not a production network benchmark.

idleAndAdmin.method: Local React mocked API, 4x Chromium CPU. Idle: warm 5-second real-time windows with countdown enabled. Admin/Superadmin: authorized entry, median of 3 cold page navigations; PIN verification cost measured separately. Not physical hardware.

    FROM arena_fight_stations member JOIN arena_registrations r ON r.station_id=member.station_id
    JOIN arena_stations station ON station.id=r.station_id

    JOIN arena_activities a ON a.id=r.activity_id AND a.station_id=r.station_id

AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arena_fights scoped WHERE scoped.id=member.fight_id AND scoped.scope_json IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arena_fight_activity_rules rule WHERE rule.fight_id=member.fight_id AND rule.station_id=r.station_id AND rule.activity_id=r.activity_id)) AND r.registered_at>=?       AND (r.voided_at IS NULL OR (?=1 AND r.voided_at>=?))
